def blue_star_picked_up(env): return env.picked_up == "blue star"

def blue_pyramid_on_right(env): return env.goal_reached

The functions perform pure reads of env attributes, no mutation of env or episode_memory, no imports, no actions or side effects, and the syntax is executable Python.
